name: The Island
extentNote: PLAN 5: from Heelsum in the west to Pannerden in the east, and from north of Arnhem to Groesbeek and Overasselt in the south. Widened to take in Ginkel Heath (DZ Y) in the north-west and the ground south of Groesbeek (DZ N).
mapUnits: km, x east and y south from the north-west corner

elevation.attribution: SRTM 1 arc-second (NASA/USGS), via the AWS Terrain Tiles open dataset

buildings.attribution: Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG), Kadaster, via PDOK
buildings.rule: 1944 built-up area: BAG building footprints (PDOK) with bouwjaar up to maxYear. A hex is built-up when those footprints cover at least minFootprintShare of it, or when at least coreMinShare of it lies inside a settlement-core mask from the overrides file. Decision 0006.

overrides.source: docs/history/map.md (Removed post-war features): A12 near Arnhem opened 1957 and 1961.
docs/history/map.md (Removed post-war features): first A50 section opened 1957.

PLAN 9 step 4 names the A325 as post-war; docs/history/map.md (Removed post-war features) records that work on its predecessor Rijksweg 52 began during the war. TODO(history): whether any of it was usable in September 1944.
docs/history/map.md (Removed post-war features): the A15 meets the A325 at knooppunt Ressen, opened 1980. TODO(history): opening year of the A15 west of Ressen.
docs/history/map.md (Removed post-war features): main A73 sections from 1986. TODO(history): opening year of the short section west of Nijmegen.
TODO(history): no source found for the opening year of the A348 (former Rijksweg 48) between Arnhem and Dieren.
docs/history/map.md (Removed post-war features): opened 18 December 1977 as the Roermondspleinbrug.
docs/history/map.md (Removed post-war features): dug 2013–2015, opened 3 December 2015.
docs/history/map.md (Settlement cores): Arnhem's centre was badly damaged in 1944 and rebuilt after 1945, so BAG under-counts it.
docs/history/map.md (Settlement cores): the Bovenstad was largely destroyed in the bombing of 22 February 1944.
docs/history/map.md (Settlement cores): the Benedenstad was part of the 1944 inner city.
docs/history/map.md (Heath): Renkum Heath, landing area of DZ X, LZ X and LZ Z.
